subject.title: fix(deps): keep archive and MCP paths on patched releases

question: Should OpenClaw accept a version-specific minimum-release-age exception for `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0` in order to resolve the MCP HTTP dependency path to `@hono/node-server@2.0.12` now?
rationale: The code change is mechanically small, but the repository deliberately uses a cooling period for fresh packages; whether the security urgency outweighs that supply-chain policy cannot be inferred safely from the diff alone.

options.title: Approve the bounded exception
options.body: Accept the exact SDK 1.30.0 exception after confirming registry provenance, the final resolved graph, and exact-head CI.

options.title: Keep the cooling period
options.body: Defer the MCP SDK major-path update and pursue a patched compatible dependency resolution without bypassing the normal release-age policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded exception
recommendation.body: Accept the exact SDK 1.30.0 exception after confirming registry provenance, the final resolved graph, and exact-head CI.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR evidence identifies vincentkoc as the security-operations contributor who prepared the version-bounded remediation and its dependency-contract review.
